_comment: Recorded map-app perf baseline (PRD #163). The contract #169 diffs the post-PRD re-measure against. Numbers are the 2026-06-13 measured baseline from PRD #163's 'Baseline & target metrics' table. RELATIVE local-dev numbers (npm run dev + scripts/serve.py + uvicorn, dev/dev, #/explore cold reload, Apple silicon, no throttle, no gzip, unminified dev bundle) — NOT prod absolutes. Reproduce with scripts/perf/ (see README.md). No PII / no prod data.

methodology.stack: npm run dev (5173) + python scripts/serve.py 8765 + AUTH_DEV_MODE=1 uvicorn backend.app.main:app (8000)
methodology.auth: signed in as the dev credential (dev/dev)
methodology.conditions: Apple silicon, no network throttle, no gzip (dev), unminified dev bundle
methodology.note: relative numbers for like-for-like comparison, not prod absolutes

A.name: Time-to-first-tower, Explore cold
A.breakdown: 375 ms DuckDB init + 628 ms probe+union+marshal of 80,814 features

B.name: DuckDB-WASM init on the tower critical path

D.name: Parcel rendering uniformity
D.target: all in-view parcels present together at Z_on

F.name: Perceived wait arriving at Explore from Dashboard

owners_filter_json.note: transfer-bound, not parse-bound; prod Caddy already gzips it (~2 MB). The worker-parse idea (PR4) was dropped after this measurement.
